title: AdaClearGrasp: Learning Adaptive Clearing for Zero-Shot Robust Dexterous Grasping in Densely Cluttered Environments
authors: Zixuan Chen, Wenquan Zhang, Jing Fang, Ruiming Zeng, Zhixuan Xu, Yiwen Hou, Xinke Wang, Jieqi Shi, Jing Huo, Yang Gao

tldr.zh: AdaClearGrasp 让 VLM 根据场景和执行反馈决定直接抓取还是先推拉清障，通过 MCP 调用几何规划技能与 PPO 训练的 GeoGrasp 抓取策略，并在失败后重新规划，实现密集杂物中的目标抓取。
tldr.en: AdaClearGrasp uses a VLM to choose direct grasping or push/pull clearing from the scene and execution feedback, invokes geometric planning skills and a PPO-trained GeoGrasp policy through MCP, and replans after failures to grasp targets in dense clutter.

evaluation_scope.zh: 上层 Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct 输出工具调用与参数，清障／复位采用几何规划，失败反馈修改后续技能选择。GeoGrasp 为 PPO 训练的 MLP：59 维观测包含 18 个手部关键点到物体最近点的归一化向量、目标高度和末端高度／姿态；输出 19 维关节增量（机械臂 7＋XHand 12），经 PD 执行。在无杂物环境中用 Cube、Cup、Apple 训练，评测未见物体与无需微调的真机迁移；真机为 xArm7＋XHand，几何观测依赖物体模型与 FoundationPose 位姿估计。配套 Clutter-Bench 含 7 个目标×3 个杂乱等级×10 个布局，共 210 个仿真场景；真机报告 18 个场景。
evaluation_scope.en: The Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct planner emits tool calls and parameters; geometric planners execute clearing/reset skills, and failure reports change subsequent skill selection. GeoGrasp is a PPO-trained MLP with 59-D observations: normalized nearest-point vectors from 18 hand keypoints, target height, and TCP height/orientation. It outputs 19 joint increments (7 arm + 12 XHand) executed by PD control. Training uses Cube, Cup and Apple without clutter; evaluation covers unseen objects and real-robot transfer without fine-tuning. Hardware uses xArm7 + XHand; geometric observations require object meshes and FoundationPose pose estimates. Clutter-Bench contains 7 targets × 3 clutter levels × 10 layouts = 210 simulation scenes; hardware evaluation reports 18 scenes.
